/- GID: D5/S3/Quantum/Hiai/ReverseTraceYoung
   generality: G
   mirror-B: D5/B/S3/Quantum/Hiai/ReverseTraceYoung

   anchors: []
   utility: none
   digest: Reverse trace Young with an attained positive definite minimum. -/

import D5.S3.Quantum.Hiai.InverseMeanVariational
import Mathlib.Analysis.MeanInequalities

/- The classical tracial Young variational formula is used in the Carlen-Lieb
   method, arXiv:0710.4167, and Zhang's variational method. The proof here
   consumes the attributed general Schatten Holder supplier. No originality
   is claimed for the inequality or its variational interpretation. -/

noncomputable section
namespace D5.S3.Quantum.Hiai.ReverseTraceYoung
open scoped MatrixOrder Matrix.Norms.L2Operator ComplexOrder
open Matrix InverseMeanVariational
variable {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
local instance : Pow (Matrix d d ℂ) ℝ := ⟨CFC.rpow⟩

/-- The product inside the trace is not required to be selfadjoint. -/
def objective (a : ℝ) (M W : Matrix d d ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (Matrix.trace (M * (W ^ (1 - a)))).re + (a - 1) * (Matrix.trace W).re

private lemma half_square {M : Matrix d d ℂ} (hM : M.PosDef) :
    (M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * (M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) = M := by
  rw [← CFC.rpow_add hM.isUnit]
  norm_num
  exact CFC.rpow_one M hM.posSemidef.nonneg

private lemma holder_trace {M W : Matrix d d ℂ} (hM : M.PosDef) (hW : W.PosDef)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) :
    tracePower (1 / a) M ≤
      (Matrix.trace (M * (W ^ (1 - a)))).re ^ (1 / a) *
        (Matrix.trace W).re ^ ((a - 1) / a) ∧
      0 ≤ (Matrix.trace (M * (W ^ (1 - a)))).re ∧ 0 ≤ (Matrix.trace W).re := by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have ham : 0 < a - 1 := by linarith
  let H := M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let J := W ^ ((1 - a) / 2)
  let U := H * J
  let V := W ^ ((a - 1) / 2)
  let r := 2 / a
  let q := 2 / (a - 1)
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have hH : Hᴴ = H := (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := M))).star_eq
  have hJ : Jᴴ = J := (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := W))).star_eq
  have hV : Vᴴ = V := (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := W))).star_eq
  have hJJ : J * J = W ^ (1 - a) := by
    dsimp [J]
    rw [← CFC.rpow_add hW.isUnit]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hUV : U * V = H := by
    dsimp [U, V, J]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← CFC.rpow_add hW.isUnit]
    rw [show (1 - a) / 2 + (a - 1) / 2 = 0 by ring,
      CFC.rpow_zero W hW.posSemidef.nonneg, mul_one]
  have hnormH : schattenNorm (U * V) r ^ r = tracePower (1 / a) M := by
    rw [hUV, norm_rpow_gram _ hr, hH, half_square hM]
    congr 1
    dsimp [r]
    ring
  have hnormU : schattenNorm U 2 ^ (2 : ℝ) =
      (Matrix.trace (M * (W ^ (1 - a)))).re := by
    rw [norm_rpow_gram U (by norm_num)]
    have hgram : Uᴴ * U = J * M * J := by
      simp only [U, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hH, hJ, mul_assoc]
      rw [← mul_assoc H H J, half_square hM]
    norm_num only [tracePower, show (2 : ℝ) / 2 = 1 by norm_num]
    rw [CFC.rpow_one _ (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self U).nonneg, hgram]
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hJJ, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  have hnormV : schattenNorm V q ^ q = (Matrix.trace W).re := by
    rw [norm_rpow_gram V hq, hV]
    dsimp [V, tracePower]
    rw [← CFC.rpow_add hW.isUnit]
    rw [show (a - 1) / 2 + (a - 1) / 2 = a - 1 by ring,
      CFC.rpow_rpow W (a - 1) (q / 2) ham.ne' hW.isStrictlyPositive]
    rw [show (a - 1) * (q / 2) = 1 by dsimp [q]; field_simp,
      CFC.rpow_one W hW.posSemidef.nonneg]
  have hQ : 0 ≤ (Matrix.trace (M * (W ^ (1 - a)))).re := by
    rw [← hnormU]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNorm_nonneg U _) _
  have hS : 0 ≤ (Matrix.trace W).re := by
    rw [← hnormV]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (schattenNorm_nonneg V _) _
  refine ⟨?_, hQ, hS⟩
  have hh := schattenNorm_mul_le U V hr (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ)) hq
    (by dsimp [r, q]; field_simp; ring : 1 / r = 1 / 2 + 1 / q)
  have hh' := Real.rpow_le_rpow (schattenNorm_nonneg (U * V) _) hh hr.le
  rw [hnormH, Real.mul_rpow (schattenNorm_nonneg U _) (schattenNorm_nonneg V _)] at hh'
  have hUp : schattenNorm U 2 ^ r =
      (Matrix.trace (M * (W ^ (1 - a)))).re ^ (1 / a) := by
    rw [← hnormU, ← Real.rpow_mul (schattenNorm_nonneg U _)]
    congr 1
    dsimp [r]
    ring
  have hVp : schattenNorm V q ^ r = (Matrix.trace W).re ^ ((a - 1) / a) := by
    rw [← hnormV, ← Real.rpow_mul (schattenNorm_nonneg V _)]
    congr 1
    dsimp [r, q]
    field_simp
  rwa [hUp, hVp] at hh'

/-- Reverse trace Young for all a ≥ 1 and all finite dimensions, without commutation. -/
theorem reverse_trace_young {M W : Matrix d d ℂ} (hM : M.PosDef) (hW : W.PosDef)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) : a * tracePower (1 / a) M ≤ objective a M W := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with ha | ha
  · rw [← ha]
    simp [objective, tracePower, CFC.rpow_one M hM.posSemidef.nonneg,
      CFC.rpow_zero W hW.posSemidef.nonneg]
  · have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hh, hQ, hS⟩ := holder_trace hM hW ha
    have hw : 1 / a + (a - 1) / a = 1 := by field_simp; ring
    have hg := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 / a) (by positivity : 0 ≤ (a - 1) / a) hQ hS hw
    calc
      a * tracePower (1 / a) M ≤
          a * ((1 / a) * (Matrix.trace (M * (W ^ (1 - a)))).re +
            ((a - 1) / a) * (Matrix.trace W).re) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hh.trans hg) ha0.le
      _ = objective a M W := by unfold objective; field_simp

/-- The positive definite optimizer M^(1/a) attains the unconditional global minimum.
No attainment over the positive definite cone is asserted for singular M. -/
theorem minimum_and_attainment {M : Matrix d d ℂ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
    ∃ W₀ : Matrix d d ℂ, W₀.PosDef ∧ W₀ = M ^ (1 / a) ∧
      objective a M W₀ = a * tracePower (1 / a) M ∧
      ∀ W : Matrix d d ℂ, W.PosDef → objective a M W₀ ≤ objective a M W := by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hW : (M ^ (1 / a)).PosDef := (hM.isStrictlyPositive.rpow M (1 / a)).posDef
  have heq : objective a M (M ^ (1 / a)) = a * tracePower (1 / a) M := by
    have hprod : M * ((M ^ (1 / a)) ^ (1 - a)) = M ^ (1 / a) := by
      rw [CFC.rpow_rpow M (1 / a) (1 - a) (by positivity) hM.isStrictlyPositive]
      conv_lhs => lhs; rw [← CFC.rpow_one M hM.posSemidef.nonneg]
      rw [← CFC.rpow_add hM.isUnit]
      congr 1
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [objective, hprod, tracePower]
    ring
  refine ⟨M ^ (1 / a), hW, rfl, heq, ?_⟩
  intro W hW'
  rw [heq]
  exact reverse_trace_young hM hW' ha

#print axioms reverse_trace_young
#print axioms minimum_and_attainment
end D5.S3.Quantum.Hiai.ReverseTraceYoung

/-- The divided-difference matrix of a common positive-spectrum resolvent budget is positive
semidefinite, with its diagonal computed from the actual derivative of the budget curve. -/
theorem multiscale_loewner_constraint
    (M : Nat) (nu : Measure Real) (scale : Fin M -> Real)
    (scalePositive : forall i, 0 < scale i)
    (scaleInjective : Function.Injective scale)
    (budgetIntegrable : forall t, 0 < t ->
      Integrable (fun xi : Real => (xi ^ 2 + t)⁻¹) nu) :
    let budget : Real -> Real := fun t => ∫ xi : Real, (xi ^ 2 + t)⁻¹ ∂nu
    let loewner : Matrix (Fin M) (Fin M) Real := fun i j =>
      if i = j then -deriv budget (scale i)
      else (budget (scale i) - budget (scale j)) / (scale j - scale i)
    PosSemidef loewner := by
  dsimp only
  have kernelIntegrable : forall i j,
      Integrable (fun xi : Real =>
        ((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹) nu := by
    intro i j
    have leftIntegrable := budgetIntegrable (scale i) (scalePositive i)
    have rightIntegrable := budgetIntegrable (scale j) (scalePositive j)
    have leftBound : forall xi : Real,
        ‖(xi ^ 2 + scale i)⁻¹‖ <= (scale i)⁻¹ := by
      intro xi
      have denominatorPositive : 0 < xi ^ 2 + scale i :=
        add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg xi) (scalePositive i)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr denominatorPositive.le)]
      exact inv_anti₀ (scalePositive i) (le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg xi))
    have productIntegrable := rightIntegrable.bdd_mul leftIntegrable.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all nu leftBound)
    simpa only [_root_.mul_inv_rev, mul_comm] using productIntegrable
  let kernel : Matrix (Fin M) (Fin M) Real := fun i j =>
    ∫ xi : Real, ((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹ ∂nu
  have kernelHermitian : kernel.IsHermitian := by
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
    intro i j
    simp only [kernel, star_trivial]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with xi
    rw [mul_comm]
  have kernelPSD : PosSemidef kernel := by
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg kernelHermitian
    intro x
    have quadraticIdentity :
        star x ⬝ᵥ (kernel *ᵥ x) =
          ∫ xi : Real, (∑ i, x i * (xi ^ 2 + scale i)⁻¹) ^ 2 ∂nu := by
      change (∑ i, x i * ∑ j,
        (∫ xi : Real, ((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹ ∂nu) * x j) = _
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      have termIntegral (i j : Fin M) :
          x i * ((∫ xi : Real,
            ((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹ ∂nu) * x j) =
            ∫ xi : Real,
              x i * (((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹ * x j) ∂nu := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const]
      simp_rw [termIntegral]
      have termIntegrable (i j : Fin M) :
          Integrable (fun xi : Real =>
            x i * (((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹ * x j)) nu := by
        simpa [mul_assoc] using
          (kernelIntegrable i j).mul_const (x j) |>.const_mul (x i)
      have innerIntegral (i : Fin M) :
          (∑ j, ∫ xi : Real,
              x i * (((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹ * x j) ∂nu) =
            ∫ xi : Real, ∑ j,
              x i * (((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹ * x j) ∂nu := by
        exact (MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum Finset.univ
          (fun j _ => termIntegrable i j)).symm
      simp_rw [innerIntegral]
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum]
      · apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [] with xi
        let total : Real := ∑ i, x i * (xi ^ 2 + scale i)⁻¹
        change (∑ i, ∑ j,
          x i * (((xi ^ 2 + scale i) * (xi ^ 2 + scale j))⁻¹ * x j)) = total ^ 2
        rw [pow_two total]
        dsimp only [total]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        congr 1
        funext i
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        funext j
        field_simp
      · intro i _
        exact integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => termIntegrable i j)
    rw [quadraticIdentity]

  have budgetDerivative : forall i,
      HasDerivAt
        (fun t => ∫ xi : Real, (xi ^ 2 + t)⁻¹ ∂nu)
        (-kernel i i) (scale i) := by
    intro i
    have halfPositive : 0 < scale i / 2 := half_pos (scalePositive i)
    have neighborhood : Ioi (scale i / 2) ∈ nhds (scale i) :=
      Ioi_mem_nhds (by linarith [scalePositive i])
    have halfIntegrable :
        Integrable (fun xi : Real => (xi ^ 2 + scale i / 2)⁻¹) nu :=
      budgetIntegrable _ halfPositive
    have resolventBound : forall xi : Real,
        ‖(xi ^ 2 + scale i / 2)⁻¹‖ <= 2 / scale i := by
      intro xi
      have denominatorPositive : 0 < xi ^ 2 + scale i / 2 :=
        add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg xi) halfPositive
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr denominatorPositive.le)]
      calc
        (xi ^ 2 + scale i / 2)⁻¹ <= (scale i / 2)⁻¹ :=
          inv_anti₀ halfPositive (le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg xi))
        _ = 2 / scale i := by field_simp
    have squareIntegrable :
        Integrable (fun xi : Real => (xi ^ 2 + scale i / 2)⁻¹ ^ 2) nu := by
      have productIntegrable := halfIntegrable.mul_bdd halfIntegrable.aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all nu resolventBound)
      simpa [pow_two] using productIntegrable
    have derivativeResult :=
      hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (F := fun t xi : Real => (xi ^ 2 + t)⁻¹)
        (F' := fun t xi : Real => -((xi ^ 2 + t)⁻¹ ^ 2))
        (bound := fun xi : Real => (xi ^ 2 + scale i / 2)⁻¹ ^ 2)
        neighborhood
        (by
          filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds (scalePositive i)] with t ht
          exact (budgetIntegrable t ht).aestronglyMeasurable)

        (by
          apply AEStronglyMeasurable.congr
            (kernelIntegrable i i).neg.aestronglyMeasurable
          filter_upwards [] with xi
          simp only [Pi.neg_apply, pow_two, _root_.mul_inv_rev])
        (by
          filter_upwards [] with xi
          intro t ht
          change scale i / 2 < t at ht
          have lowerDenominatorPositive : 0 < xi ^ 2 + scale i / 2 :=
            add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg xi) halfPositive

            linarith [sq_nonneg xi, ht]
          have inverseLe : (xi ^ 2 + t)⁻¹ <= (xi ^ 2 + scale i / 2)⁻¹ :=
            inv_anti₀ lowerDenominatorPositive (by linarith [ht])
          rw [norm_neg, norm_pow,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr denominatorPositive.le)]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr denominatorPositive.le) inverseLe 2)
        squareIntegrable
        (by
          filter_upwards [] with xi
          intro t ht
          change scale i / 2 < t at ht
          have denominatorNe : xi ^ 2 + t ≠ 0 := by
            exact ne_of_gt (by linarith [sq_nonneg xi, ht])
          have denominatorDerivative : HasDerivAt (fun y : Real => xi ^ 2 + y) 1 t :=
            (hasDerivAt_id t).const_add (xi ^ 2)
          have inverseDerivative := denominatorDerivative.inv denominatorNe
          change HasDerivAt (fun y : Real => (xi ^ 2 + y)⁻¹)
            (-1 / (xi ^ 2 + t) ^ 2) t at inverseDerivative
          convert! inverseDerivative using 1
          simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, neg_mul, one_mul, inv_pow])
    simpa only [kernel, pow_two, _root_.mul_inv_rev, MeasureTheory.integral_neg] using
      derivativeResult.2
  have loewnerEqKernel :
      (fun i j : Fin M =>
        if i = j then
          -deriv (fun t => ∫ xi : Real, (xi ^ 2 + t)⁻¹ ∂nu) (scale i)
        else
          ((∫ xi : Real, (xi ^ 2 + scale i)⁻¹ ∂nu) -
            (∫ xi : Real, (xi ^ 2 + scale j)⁻¹ ∂nu)) /
            (scale j - scale i)) = kernel := by
    funext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [if_pos]
      rw [(budgetDerivative i).deriv]
      simp
    · simp only [if_neg hij]
      have scaleNe : scale j - scale i ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (scaleInjective.ne hij).symm
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub (budgetIntegrable _ (scalePositive i))
        (budgetIntegrable _ (scalePositive j)), ← MeasureTheory.integral_div]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with xi
      have leftNe : xi ^ 2 + scale i ≠ 0 :=
        ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg xi) (scalePositive i))
      have rightNe : xi ^ 2 + scale j ≠ 0 :=
        ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg xi) (scalePositive j))
      field_simp [leftNe, rightNe, scaleNe]
      ring

#print axioms multiscale_loewner_constraint

private theorem chain_profile_kernel {K V ι : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] [Fintype ι]
    (f : Module.End K V) (s : ι → ℕ+) (b : Basis (Σ i, Fin (s i)) K V)
    (hrank : ∀ m, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (f ^ m)) =

    blockKernelTower (Finset.univ.val.map s) m =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m)) := by

    simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b

      ∑ i, (s i : ℕ) := by

private theorem profiles_eq {left right : BlockMultiset}

/-- The finite-map loss theorem with actual Jordan chains on the transient
Fitting summand. The positive chain lengths realize the previously abstract
multiset, so both block counts in the conclusion count genuine chains. -/
theorem information_loss_layers_from_actual_jordan_chains
    {Y : Type*} [Finite Y] (tau : Y → Y) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (s : ι → ℕ+)
      (b : Basis (Σ i, Fin (s i)) ℂ (transientSubspace tau (Nat.card Y))),
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (i : ι) (j : Fin (s i)),
        (transientTransfer tau (Nat.card Y) ^ m) (b ⟨i, j⟩) =
          if h : j.val + m < s i then b ⟨i, ⟨j.val + m, h⟩⟩ else 0) ∧
      Finset.univ.val.map s = transferZeroBlocks tau ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k →
        (informationLossLayer tau k =
            Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (transferOperator tau ^ k.pred)) -
              Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (transferOperator tau ^ k)) ∧
          informationLossLayer tau k = blockCountAtLeast (Finset.univ.val.map s) k) ∧
        blockCountExactly (Finset.univ.val.map s) k =
          informationLossLayer tau k - informationLossLayer tau (k + 1) ∧
        totalInformationLoss tau = Nat.card Y - Nat.card (PeriodicCore tau) := by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite Y
  let : AddCommGroup (transientSubspace tau (Nat.card Y)) :=
    (transientSubspace tau (Nat.card Y)).addCommGroup
  let : Module ℂ (transientSubspace tau (Nat.card Y)) :=

noncomputable def root {n : ℕ} (A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :=
  ⟨CFC.rpow A.val (1/3 : ℝ), (Matrix.LE.le.posSemidef (CFC.rpow_nonneg (a := A.val) (y := (1/3 : ℝ)))).isHermitian⟩

lemma root_posdef {n : ℕ} (A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hA : A.val.PosDef) : (root A).val.PosDef :=
  Matrix.IsStrictlyPositive.posDef (IsStrictlyPositive.rpow A.val (1/3 : ℝ) hA.isStrictlyPositive)

private lemma root_cube {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hY : Y.val.PosDef) : root (cube Y) = Y := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change CFC.rpow (cube Y).val (1/3 : ℝ) = Y.val
  rw [cube_val,← CFC.rpow_natCast Y.val 3 hY.posSemidef.nonneg]
  change CFC.rpow (CFC.rpow Y.val (3 : ℝ)) (1/3 : ℝ) = Y.val
  calc
    _ = CFC.rpow Y.val ((3 : ℝ)*(1/3 : ℝ)) :=
      CFC.rpow_rpow Y.val 3 (1/3) (by norm_num) hY.isStrictlyPositive
    _ = Y.val := by norm_num; exact CFC.rpow_one Y.val hY.posSemidef.nonneg

private lemma cube_root {n : ℕ} (A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hA : A.val.PosDef) : cube (root A) = A := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [cube_val]
  change (CFC.rpow A.val (1/3 : ℝ))^3 = A.val
  rw [← CFC.rpow_natCast (CFC.rpow A.val (1/3 : ℝ)) 3 CFC.rpow_nonneg]
  change CFC.rpow (CFC.rpow A.val (1/3 : ℝ)) (3 : ℝ) = A.val
  calc
    _ = CFC.rpow A.val ((1/3 : ℝ)*(3 : ℝ)) :=
      CFC.rpow_rpow A.val (1/3) 3 (by norm_num) hA.isStrictlyPositive
    _ = A.val := by norm_num; exact CFC.rpow_one A.val hA.posSemidef.nonneg

private lemma positive_open (n : ℕ) : IsOpen {A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) | A.val.PosDef} :=
  D5.S3.Geometry.AlphaGeometry.HermitianDensityCoordinates.hermitian_posdef_open n

private lemma cube_hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hY : Y.val.PosDef) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt cube
      (cubeDerivativeEquiv Y hY : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) →L[ℝ] (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) Y := by
  apply (cube_contDiff n).contDiffAt.hasStrictFDerivAt' _ (by simp)
  exact cube_hasFDerivAt Y

private noncomputable def cubeLocalEquiv {n : ℕ}
    (Y : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (hY : Y.val.PosDef) :
    OpenPartialHomeomorph (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
      (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :=
  (cube_hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv Y hY).toOpenPartialHomeomorph cube

private lemma root_localInverse_identification {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hY : Y.val.PosDef) :
    root =ᶠ[𝓝 (cube Y)] (cubeLocalEquiv Y hY).symm := by
  apply (cube_hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv Y hY).localInverse_unique
  filter_upwards [(positive_open n).mem_nhds hY] with X hX
  exact root_cube X hX

lemma root_contDiffAt_cube {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hY : Y.val.PosDef) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) root (cube Y) := by
  have hf : HasFDerivAt cube
      (cubeDerivativeEquiv Y hY : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) →L[ℝ] (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) Y := cube_hasFDerivAt Y
  have hc := (cube_contDiff n).contDiffAt.to_localInverse hf (by simp : (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0)
  exact hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq (root_localInverse_identification Y hY)

private lemma root_contDiffAt {n : ℕ} (A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hA : A.val.PosDef) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) root A := by
  simpa only [cube_root A hA] using root_contDiffAt_cube (root A) (root_posdef A hA)

noncomputable def rhoH {n : ℕ} (x : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ)) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) := (selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (rho x)

lemma rhoH_val {n : ℕ} (x : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ)) : (rhoH x).val = rho x :=
  (rho_isHermitian x).isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ

private lemma rho_contDiff (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (@rho n) := by
  unfold rho
  fun_prop

private lemma rhoH_contDiff (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (@rhoH n) :=
  ((selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).contDiff.comp (rho_contDiff n)

private def rhoLinearMap (n : ℕ) : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :=
  ∑ k, (LinearMap.proj k).smulRight (G n k)

private def rhoLinear (n : ℕ) : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :=
  ((selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).comp (rhoLinearMap n).toContinuousLinearMap

private lemma rhoH_affine {n : ℕ} (x : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ)) : rhoH x = rhoH 0 + rhoLinear n x := by
  have he : (rhoLinearMap n) x = ∑ k, x k • G n k := by
    simp [rhoLinearMap]
  change (selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (rho x) =
    (selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (rho 0) +
      (selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) ((rhoLinearMap n) x)
  rw [he]
  simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) [rho, map_add]

private lemma rhoH_hasFDerivAt {n : ℕ} (x : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ)) : HasFDerivAt rhoH (rhoLinear n) x := by
  have hp := (rhoLinear n).hasFDerivAt (x := x) |>.const_add (rhoH 0)
  convert hp using 1 <;> try rfl
  funext t
  exact rhoH_affine t

private lemma rhoLinear_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Function.Injective (rhoLinear n) := by
  intro x y he
  have hr : rhoH x = rhoH y := (rhoH_affine x).trans ((congrArg (fun V : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) => rhoH 0 + V) he).trans (rhoH_affine y).symm)
  have hm : rho x = rho y := by simpa only [rhoH_val] using congrArg Subtype.val hr
  have hc := congrArg chartPoint hm
  rwa [chart_left_inverse hn x,chart_left_inverse hn y] at hc

def immersion {n : ℕ} (x : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ)) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) := root (rhoH x)

lemma immersion_contDiffAt {n : ℕ} (x : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ)) (hx : (rho x).PosDef) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) immersion x := by
  apply (root_contDiffAt (rhoH x) (by rwa [rhoH_val])).comp x (rhoH_contDiff n).contDiffAt

private lemma root_derivative_leftInverse {n : ℕ} (A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hA : A.val.PosDef) :
    (cubeDerivative (root A)).toContinuousLinearMap.comp (fderiv ℝ root A) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) := by
  have hr := root_contDiffAt A hA
  have hd := (cube_hasFDerivAt (root A)).comp A (hr.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have he : (cube ∘ (@root n)) =ᶠ[𝓝 A] id := by
    filter_upwards [(positive_open n).mem_nhds hA] with B hB
    exact cube_root B hB
  have hdf := he.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
  have hid : fderiv ℝ (id : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) → (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) A = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) := fderiv_id
  rw [hd.fderiv,hid] at hdf
  exact hdf

private lemma root_derivative_injective {n : ℕ} (A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hA : A.val.PosDef) :
    Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ root A) := by
  intro V W hVW
  have he := root_derivative_leftInverse A hA
  have hh := congrArg (fun f : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) →L[ℝ] (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) => f V) he
  have hh' := congrArg (fun f : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) →L[ℝ] (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) => f W) he
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using hh.symm.trans ((congrArg (cubeDerivative (root A)) hVW).trans hh')

lemma immersion_derivative_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ))
    (hx : (rho x).PosDef) : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ immersion x) := by
  have hp : (rhoH x).val.PosDef := by rwa [rhoH_val]
  change Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (root ∘ rhoH) x)
  rw [fderiv_comp x ((root_contDiffAt (rhoH x) hp).differentiableAt (by simp)) (rhoH_hasFDerivAt x).differentiableAt,
    (rhoH_hasFDerivAt x).fderiv]
  exact (root_derivative_injective (rhoH x) hp).comp (rhoLinear_injective hn)

lemma immersion_level_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : (Fin (n ^ 2 - 1) → ℝ)) (hx : (rho x).PosDef) :
    F (immersion x) = 1 := by
  have hp : (rhoH x).val.PosDef := by rwa [rhoH_val]
  have hc := congrArg Subtype.val (cube_root (rhoH x) hp)
  rw [cube_val,rhoH_val] at hc
  change ((root (rhoH x)).val^3).trace.re = 1
  rw [hc,D5.S3.Geometry.AlphaGeometry.HermitianDensityCoordinates.rho_trace hn]
  rfl

lemma herm_inner_smul_left {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (A B : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :
    herm_inner (c • A) B = c*herm_inner A B := by
  simp [herm_inner,Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.trace_smul,RCLike.smul_re,smul_eq_mul]

lemma herm_inner_smul_right {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (A B : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :
    herm_inner A (c • B) = c*herm_inner A B := by
  simp [herm_inner,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.trace_smul,RCLike.smul_re,smul_eq_mul]

lemma herm_inner_add_right {n : ℕ} (A B C : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :
    herm_inner A (B+C) = herm_inner A B + herm_inner A C := by
  simp [herm_inner,Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.trace_add]

lemma herm_inner_symm {n : ℕ} (A B : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) : herm_inner A B = herm_inner B A := by
  rw [herm_inner,Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  rfl

lemma trace_pow_eq_eigenvalues {n : ℕ}
    (Y : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (k : ℕ) :
    (Y.val ^ k).trace.re = ∑ i, (Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) ^ k := by
  let hY : Y.val.IsHermitian := Y.property.isHermitian
  have he : RHLinalg.specMap hY (fun t => t ^ k) = Y.val ^ k := by
    unfold RHLinalg.specMap
    conv_rhs => rw [hY.spectral_theorem]
    rw [← map_pow, Matrix.diagonal_pow]
    congr 1
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Function.comp_def]
  have ht := RHLinalg.rtrace_specMap hY (fun t => t ^ k)
  rw [he] at ht
  exact ht

noncomputable def S4 {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) : ℝ := (Y.val^4).trace.re

lemma S4_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) : S4 Y = ∑ i, Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues i^4 :=
  trace_pow_eq_eigenvalues Y 4

lemma S4_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hY : Y.val.PosDef) : 0 < S4 Y := by
  rw [S4_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_pos
  · intro i _
    exact pow_pos (hY.eigenvalues_pos i) 4
  · letI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0,hn⟩⟩
    exact Finset.univ_nonempty

noncomputable def normal {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :=
  (Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹ • (⟨Y.val^2,Y.property.pow 2⟩ : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)))

lemma normal_val {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) :
    (normal Y).val = (Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹ • Y.val^2 := rfl

lemma normal_unit {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hS : 0 < S4 Y) :
    herm_inner (normal Y).val (normal Y).val = 1 := by
  rw [normal_val,herm_inner_smul_left,herm_inner_smul_right]
  have hp : herm_inner (Y.val^2) (Y.val^2) = S4 Y := by
    change (Y.val^2*Y.val^2).trace.re = (Y.val^4).trace.re
    rw [← pow_add]
  rw [hp]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hS.le
  have hn : Real.sqrt (S4 Y) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hS)
  field_simp
  nlinarith

lemma DF_normal {n : ℕ} (Y V : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hS : 0 < S4 Y) :
    fderiv ℝ F Y V = 3*Real.sqrt (S4 Y)*herm_inner (normal Y).val V.val := by
  rw [F_fderiv,normal_val,herm_inner_smul_left]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hS)]

    ((((LinearMap.mul ℝ (A := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)).toContinuousBilinearMap Y.val).comp ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).subtypeL) +
      (((LinearMap.mul ℝ (A := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)).toContinuousBilinearMap).flip Y.val).comp ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).subtypeL)

  apply IsSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply

  convert hp using 1 <;> try rfl
  funext X
  apply Subtype.ext
  change X.val^2 = ((selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (X.val*X.val)).val
  rw [← pow_two]
  exact ((X.property.isHermitian.pow 2).isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ).symm

def DS4 {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (4 : ℝ) • (((Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin n) ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap)).comp (((LinearMap.mul ℝ (A := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)).toContinuousBilinearMap (Y.val^3)).comp ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).subtypeL))

private lemma trace_quartic_variation {n : ℕ} (Y V : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :
    (Y^2*(Y*V+V*Y)+(Y*V+V*Y)*Y^2).trace = 4*(Y^3*V).trace := by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.add_mul,Matrix.trace_add]
  have h1 : (Y^2*(Y*V)).trace = (Y^3*V).trace := by congr 1; noncomm_ring
  have h2 : (Y^2*(V*Y)).trace = (Y^3*V).trace := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
    congr 1 <;> noncomm_ring
  have h3 : (Y*V*Y^2).trace = (Y^3*V).trace := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
    congr 1 <;> noncomm_ring
  have h4 : (V*Y*Y^2).trace = (Y^3*V).trace := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
    congr 1 <;> noncomm_ring
  rw [h1,h2,h3,h4]
  ring

private lemma S4_hasFDerivAt {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) : HasFDerivAt S4 (DS4 Y) Y := by
  have hp := (((Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin n) ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap)).comp ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).subtypeL).hasFDerivAt.comp Y
    ((square_hasFDerivAt (square Y)).comp Y (square_hasFDerivAt Y))
  convert hp using 1 <;> try rfl
  · funext X
    change (X.val^4).trace.re = ((X.val^2)^2).trace.re
    rw [← pow_mul]
  · ext1 V
    change 4*(Y.val^3*V.val).trace.re = _
    change 4*(Y.val^3*V.val).trace.re = (jordan (square Y) (jordan Y V)).val.trace.re
    rw [jordan_val,jordan_val]
    change 4*(Y.val^3*V.val).trace.re = (Y.val^2*(Y.val*V.val+V.val*Y.val)+(Y.val*V.val+V.val*Y.val)*Y.val^2).trace.re
    rw [trace_quartic_variation]
    simp [Complex.mul_re]

def projection {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (V : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :=
  V - herm_inner (normal Y).val V.val • normal Y

private lemma inner_normal_jordan {n : ℕ} (Y V : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) :
    herm_inner (normal Y).val (jordan Y V).val =
      2*(Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹*herm_inner (Y.val^3) V.val := by
  rw [normal_val,herm_inner_smul_left,jordan_val,herm_inner_add_right]
  have h1 : herm_inner (Y.val^2) (Y.val*V.val) = herm_inner (Y.val^3) V.val := by
    unfold herm_inner
    congr 1
    congr 1 <;> noncomm_ring
  have h2 : herm_inner (Y.val^2) (V.val*Y.val) = herm_inner (Y.val^3) V.val := by
    unfold herm_inner
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.trace_mul_cycle]
    congr 1
    congr 1 <;> noncomm_ring
  rw [h1,h2]
  ring

private lemma normInv_hasFDerivAt {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hS : 0 < S4 Y) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun X : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) => (Real.sqrt (S4 X))⁻¹)
      ((-(2*(Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹^3)) •
        (((Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin n) ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap)).comp (((LinearMap.mul ℝ (A := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)).toContinuousBilinearMap (Y.val^3)).comp ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).subtypeL))) Y := by
  have hs := (S4_hasFDerivAt Y).sqrt (ne_of_gt hS)
  have hi := (hasDerivAt_inv (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hS))).comp_hasFDerivAt Y hs
  convert hi using 1 <;> try rfl
  ext1 V
  change -(2*(Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹^3)*herm_inner (Y.val^3) V.val =
    -(Real.sqrt (S4 Y)^2)⁻¹*((1/(2*Real.sqrt (S4 Y)))*(4*herm_inner (Y.val^3) V.val))
  field_simp
  <;> ring

private lemma normal_hasFDerivAt {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hS : 0 < S4 Y) :
    HasFDerivAt normal
      ((Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹ • jordan Y +
        (((-(2*(Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹^3)) •
          (((Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin n) ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap)).comp (((LinearMap.mul ℝ (A := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)).toContinuousBilinearMap (Y.val^3)).comp ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).subtypeL))).smulRight (square Y))) Y := by
  have hp := (normInv_hasFDerivAt Y hS).smul (square_hasFDerivAt Y)
  convert hp using 1 <;> try rfl

lemma regular_level_set_shape_operator {n : ℕ} (Y V : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hS : 0 < S4 Y) :
    fderiv ℝ normal Y V = (Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹ • projection Y (jordan Y V) := by
  rw [(normal_hasFDerivAt Y hS).fderiv]
  unfold projection
  rw [inner_normal_jordan]
  change _ = (Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹ •
    (jordan Y V - (2*(Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹*herm_inner (Y.val^3) V.val) •
      ((Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹ • square Y))
  simp (config := { congrConsts := false }) only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  change _ + (-(2*(Real.sqrt (S4 Y))⁻¹^3)*herm_inner (Y.val^3) V.val) • square Y = _
  module

lemma square_contDiff (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (@square n) := by
  have hv : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) => Y.val) := ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).subtypeL.contDiff
  have hm : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun p : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) × (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) => (LinearMap.mul ℝ (A := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)).toContinuousBilinearMap p.1 p.2) :=
    ((LinearMap.mul ℝ (A := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)).toContinuousBilinearMap).isBoundedBilinearMap.contDiff
  convert ((selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).contDiff.comp (hm.comp (hv.prodMk hv)) using 1 <;> try rfl
  funext Y
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Y.val^2 = ((selfAdjointPartL ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (Y.val*Y.val)).val
  rw [← pow_two]
  exact ((Y.property.isHermitian.pow 2).isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ).symm

private lemma S4_contDiff (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (@S4 n) := by
  have hp := (((Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin n) ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap)).comp ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))).subtypeL).contDiff.comp
    ((square_contDiff n).comp (square_contDiff n))
  convert hp using 1
  funext Y
  change (Y.val^4).trace.re = ((Y.val^2)^2).trace.re
  rw [← pow_mul]

lemma normal_contDiffAt {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (hS : 0 < S4 Y) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) normal Y := by
  have hs := (S4_contDiff n).contDiffAt.sqrt (ne_of_gt hS)
  have hi := hs.inv (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hS))
  convert hi.smul (square_contDiff n).contDiffAt using 1
  funext Z
  rfl

namespace Traces
private def readout {n : ℕ} : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n × Fin n → ℝ) :=
  LinearMap.pi (fun p =>
    (if p.1 ≤ p.2 then Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap else Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap).comp
      (((LinearMap.proj p.2).comp (LinearMap.proj p.1)).comp
        (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)).subtype))

private lemma readout_apply {n : ℕ}
    (A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    readout A p = if p.1 ≤ p.2 then (A.val p.1 p.2).re else (A.val p.1 p.2).im := by
  unfold readout
  simp only [LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

private def assemble {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n × Fin n → ℝ) : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) := fun r s =>
  if r=s then (x (r,s) : ℂ)
  else if r<s then (x (r,s) : ℂ) - (x (s,r) : ℂ)*Complex.I
  else (x (s,r) : ℂ) + (x (r,s) : ℂ)*Complex.I

private lemma assemble_hermitian {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n × Fin n → ℝ) : (assemble x).IsHermitian := by
  ext r s
  change star (assemble x s r) = assemble x r s
  by_cases hrs : r=s
  · subst s
    simp [assemble]
  · have hsr := Ne.symm hrs
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hrs with hlt|hgt
    · have hnot : ¬s<r := not_lt_of_gt hlt
      simp [assemble,hrs,hsr,hlt,hnot,map_add,map_sub,map_mul,sub_eq_add_neg]
    · have hnot : ¬r<s := not_lt_of_gt hgt
      simp [assemble,hrs,hsr,hgt,hnot,map_add,map_sub,map_mul,sub_eq_add_neg]

private lemma readout_assemble {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n × Fin n → ℝ) :
    readout (⟨assemble x,assemble_hermitian x⟩ : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) = x := by
  ext ⟨r,s⟩
  by_cases hrs : r=s
  · subst s
    simp [readout_apply,assemble]
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hrs with hlt|hgt
    · simp [readout_apply,assemble,hrs,hlt,hlt.le,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im]
    · simp [readout_apply,assemble,hrs,not_lt_of_gt hgt,not_le_of_gt hgt,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im]

private lemma assemble_readout {n : ℕ} (A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) : assemble (readout A) = A.val := by
  ext r s
  have hc : star (A.val s r) = A.val r s := congrFun (congrFun A.property.isHermitian.eq r) s
  have hre : (A.val s r).re = (A.val r s).re := by simpa using congrArg Complex.re hc
  have him : -(A.val s r).im = (A.val r s).im := by simpa using congrArg Complex.im hc
  by_cases hrs : r=s
  · subst s
    have hz : (A.val r r).im = 0 := by linarith
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [assemble,readout_apply,hz]
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hrs with hlt|hgt
    · apply Complex.ext <;>
        simp [assemble,readout_apply,hrs,hlt,hlt.le,not_le_of_gt hlt,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,hre,him]
    · apply Complex.ext <;>
        simp [assemble,readout_apply,hrs,not_lt_of_gt hgt,not_le_of_gt hgt,hgt.le,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,hre,him]

def readoutEquiv (n : ℕ) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n × Fin n → ℝ) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective readout ⟨by
    intro A B he
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← assemble_readout A,← assemble_readout B,he],by
    intro x
    exact ⟨⟨assemble x,assemble_hermitian x⟩,readout_assemble x⟩⟩

def diagonalH {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :=
  ⟨Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (y i : ℂ)),Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun i => by change star (y i : ℂ) = (y i : ℂ); simp)⟩

private lemma readout_jordan_diagonal {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ) (V : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    readout (jordan (diagonalH y) V) p = (y p.1+y p.2)*readout V p := by
  rw [readout_apply, readout_apply]
  change (if p.1 ≤ p.2 then ((jordan (diagonalH y) V).val p.1 p.2).re
    else ((jordan (diagonalH y) V).val p.1 p.2).im) = _
  rw [jordan_val]
  simp only [diagonalH,Matrix.add_apply,Matrix.diagonal_mul,Matrix.mul_diagonal,
    Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,mul_zero,zero_mul,sub_zero,add_zero]
  change (if p.1 ≤ p.2 then _ else _) = (y p.1+y p.2)*(if p.1 ≤ p.2 then _ else _)
  split_ifs <;> ring

lemma diagonal_conjugated_jordan {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (readoutEquiv n).conj (jordan (diagonalH y)).toLinearMap =
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun p : Fin n × Fin n => y p.1+y p.2)).toLin' := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  funext p
  change readout (jordan (diagonalH y) ((readoutEquiv n).symm x)) p = _
  rw [readout_jordan_diagonal]
  change (y p.1+y p.2)*((readoutEquiv n) ((readoutEquiv n).symm x)) p = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,Matrix.toLin'_apply]
  simp [Matrix.mulVec,Matrix.diagonal,dotProduct]

private lemma trace_diagonal_jordan {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (jordan (diagonalH y)).toLinearMap = 2*n*∑ i, y i := by
  rw [← LinearMap.trace_conj' _ (readoutEquiv n),diagonal_conjugated_jordan,Matrix.trace_toLin'_eq,Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

private lemma trace_diagonal_jordan_square {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) ((jordan (diagonalH y)).toLinearMap^2) =
      2*n*(∑ i, y i^2)+2*(∑ i, y i)^2 := by
  rw [← LinearMap.trace_conj' _ (readoutEquiv n)]
  have hp : (readoutEquiv n).conj ((jordan (diagonalH y)).toLinearMap^2) =
      ((readoutEquiv n).conj (jordan (diagonalH y)).toLinearMap)^2 :=
    (readoutEquiv n).conjRingEquiv.map_pow _ 2
  rw [hp]
  rw [diagonal_conjugated_jordan]
  have hd (A : Matrix (Fin n × Fin n) (Fin n × Fin n) ℝ) : A.toLin'^2 = (A^2).toLin' := by
    exact (Matrix.toLin'_pow A 2).symm
  rw [hd,Matrix.diagonal_pow,Matrix.trace_toLin'_eq,Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Pi.pow_apply]
  have he (i j : Fin n) : (y i+y j)^2 = y i^2+2*y i*y j+y j^2 := by ring
  simp_rw [he]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

def hermitianConj {n : ℕ} (e : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :=
  (e.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.restrictScalars ℝ).ofSubmodules
    (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (by
      ext A
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨B,hB,rfl⟩
        change star (e B) = e B
        rw [← map_star]
        exact congrArg e hB
      · intro hA
        refine ⟨e.symm A,?_,e.apply_symm_apply A⟩
        change star (e.symm A) = e.symm A
        rw [← map_star]
        exact congrArg e.symm hA)

private lemma hermitianConj_val {n : ℕ} (e : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (A : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) :
    (hermitianConj e A).val = e A.val := rfl

lemma jordan_conjugation {n : ℕ} (e : (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) :
    (hermitianConj e).conj (jordan Y).toLinearMap = (jordan (hermitianConj e Y)).toLinearMap := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro V
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (hermitianConj e (jordan Y ((hermitianConj e).symm V))).val = (jordan (hermitianConj e Y) V).val
  rw [hermitianConj_val,jordan_val,jordan_val,hermitianConj_val,map_add,map_mul,map_mul]
  change e Y.val * e (e.symm V.val) + e (e.symm V.val) * e Y.val = _
  rw [e.apply_symm_apply]

private lemma jordan_trace {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (jordan Y).toLinearMap = 2*n*∑ i, Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues i := by
  let e := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ ((Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hy : hermitianConj e (diagonalH Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues) = Y :=
    Subtype.ext Y.property.isHermitian.spectral_theorem.symm
  calc
    LinearMap.trace ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (jordan Y).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.trace ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (jordan (hermitianConj e (diagonalH Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues))).toLinearMap :=
        congrArg (fun Z : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) => LinearMap.trace ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) (jordan Z).toLinearMap) hy.symm
    _ = _ := by rw [← jordan_conjugation,LinearMap.trace_conj',trace_diagonal_jordan]

private lemma jordan_square_trace {n : ℕ} (Y : (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ ((selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))) ((jordan Y).toLinearMap^2) =
      2*n*(∑ i, Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues i^2)+2*(∑ i, Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)^2 := by
  let e := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ ((Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hy : hermitianConj e (diagonalH Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues) = Y :=
    Subtype.ext Y.property.isHermitian.spectral_theorem.symm
  have hc : (jordan Y).toLinearMap^2 =
      (hermitianConj e).conj ((jordan (diagonalH Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues)).toLinearMap^2) := by
    have hp : (hermitianConj e).conj ((jordan (diagonalH Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues)).toLinearMap^2) =
        ((hermitianConj e).conj (jordan (diagonalH Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues)).toLinearMap)^2 :=
      (hermitianConj e).conjRingEquiv.map_pow _ 2
    rw [hp,jordan_conjugation,hy]
  rw [hc,LinearMap.trace_conj',trace_diagonal_jordan_square]

theorem hermitian_jordan_operator_trace_formulas {n : ℕ}
    (Y : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
      (jordan Y).toLinearMap = 2*n*∑ i, Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ∧
    LinearMap.trace ℝ (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))
      ((jordan Y).toLinearMap^2) =
      2*n*(∑ i, Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues i^2)+
        2*(∑ i, Y.property.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)^2 :=
  ⟨jordan_trace Y, jordan_square_trace Y⟩

def rankOneProjection (f : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (u : V) : Module.End ℝ V := 1-LinearMap.smulRight f u


private lemma rankOne_mul (f : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (u : V) (K : Module.End ℝ V) :

private lemma mul_rankOne (f : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (u : V) (K : Module.End ℝ V) :

def traceX1 {d : ℕ} (A : Mat (Fin d × (Fin d × Fin d))) :
    Mat (Fin d × Fin d) :=
  fun p q => ∑ r : Fin d, A (p.1, (r, p.2)) (q.1, (r, q.2))

def traceX2 {d : ℕ} (A : Mat (Fin d × (Fin d × Fin d))) :
    Mat (Fin d × Fin d) :=
  fun p q => ∑ r : Fin d, A (p.1, (p.2, r)) (q.1, (q.2, r))

def jordanAction {d : ℕ} (Φ Ψ : Map (Fin d) (Fin d))
    (A : Mat (Fin d × (Fin d × Fin d))) :
    Mat (Fin d × (Fin d × Fin d)) :=
  MatrixMap.kron (LinearMap.id : Map (Fin d) (Fin d)) (MatrixMap.kron Φ Ψ) A

def Compatible {d : ℕ} (Φ Ψ : Map (Fin d) (Fin d)) : Prop :=
  ∃ Γ : Map (Fin d) (Fin d × Fin d), IsChannel (⇑Γ) ∧
    (∀ R, partialTraceRight (Γ R) = Φ R) ∧ (∀ R, partialTraceLeft (Γ R) = Ψ R)

def JordanCompatible {d : ℕ} (Φ Ψ : Map (Fin d) (Fin d)) : Prop :=
  ∃ A : Mat (Fin d × (Fin d × Fin d)), A.IsHermitian ∧
    traceX1 A = MatrixMap.choi_matrix (LinearMap.id : Map (Fin d) (Fin d)) ∧
    traceX2 A = MatrixMap.choi_matrix (LinearMap.id : Map (Fin d) (Fin d)) ∧
    (jordanAction Φ Ψ A).PosSemidef

def claim : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : ℕ) (Φ Ψ : Map (Fin d) (Fin d)),
    IsChannel (⇑Φ) → IsChannel (⇑Ψ) → Compatible Φ Ψ → JordanCompatible Φ Ψ

    fin_cases s <;> dsimp [E, S, leftIndex, sign] <;> module

    fin_cases t <;> dsimp [F, S, rightIndex, sign] <;> module

  have hr1 := hr 1

  dsimp [sign] at hr0 hr1 hc0 hc1 ⊢

  · calc

  · calc

      _ = (4 / 5 : ℝ) • P := by module
  · calc

      _ = _ := congrArg₂ (· - ·) hc0 hc1
      _ = (3 / 4 : ℝ) • Q := by module

    (h1 : traceX1 A = MatrixMap.choi_matrix (LinearMap.id : Map (Fin 4) (Fin 4)))
    (h2 : traceX2 A = MatrixMap.choi_matrix (LinearMap.id : Map (Fin 4) (Fin 4))) :
    (∑ s : Fin 2, ∑ t : Fin 2, (Matrix.trace (H s t * G A s t)).re) = -(1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
  have hm := G_moments A h1 h2
  have hs : (∑ s : Fin 2, ∑ t : Fin 2, H s t * G A s t) =
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) • (∑ s : Fin 2, ∑ t : Fin 2, G A s t) -
      P * (∑ s : Fin 2, ∑ t : Fin 2, sign s • G A s t) -
      Q * (∑ s : Fin 2, ∑ t : Fin 2, sign t • G A s t) := by
    unfold H
    simp only [sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.smul_sum, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_smul]
  have hv : (∑ s : Fin 2, ∑ t : Fin 2, H s t * G A s t) =
      (-(1 / 20) : ℝ) • (1 : M4) := by
    rw [hs, hm.1, hm.2.1, hm.2.2, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      pauli_facts.2.2.2.2.1, pauli_facts.2.2.2.2.2.1]
    module
  calc
    _ = (Matrix.trace (∑ s : Fin 2, ∑ t : Fin 2, H s t * G A s t)).re := by
      simp
    _ = -(1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hv, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_one, Complex.smul_re]
      norm_num

  rintro ⟨A, _, h1, h2, hT⟩
  have hn := trace_sum_nonneg A hT
  rw [trace_sum_value A h1 h2] at hn
  norm_num at hn
